#!name=苏宁易购
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mpcs\.suning\.com\/mpcs\/dm\/getDmInfo/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/image\.suning\.cn\/uimg\/ma\/ad\//i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/luckman\.suning\.com\/luck-web\/policy\/v\d\/msf\/index\.do/i then reject(200)

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, show.suning.beer,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, apm.suning.cn,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, mads.suning.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, ssac.suning.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, tad.suning.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% mpcs.suning.com, image.suning.com, luckman.suning.com
